title: Others abide our question.
html_source:
http://lit.genius.com/Matthew-arnold-shakespeare-annotated

Reported as external narrative, however it fits in with Stephen’s thoughts and is very specific, unlike Eglinton’s prior utterances. Arnold’s sonnet says exactly what Eglinton’s quote says.

The annotations above explain it succinctly.
